sloka: अंगद प्रमुखान् वीरान् वीरः कपि गण ईश्वरः ।वेग विक्रम संपन्नान् संदिदेश विशेषवित् ॥४-४१-५॥
transliteration: aṁgada pramukhān vīrān vīraḥ kapi gaṇa īśvaraḥ ।vega vikrama saṁpannān saṁdideśa viśeṣavit ॥4-41-5॥

translations.english: The extraordinary Sugriva commanded Nila, son of the firegod, Hanuman, the formidable, Jambavan, son of Brahma, Suhotra, Sarari, Saragulma, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sushena, Vrishabam, Mainda, Dvivida, Vijaya, Gandhamadana, the two sons of Firegod, Ulkamuka and Asanga including Angada, leader of the group, to proceed. All of them were endowed with speed and valour.
